about: The hub's refusal words by code (refusal_words.WORDS), as the hub writes them, with {name} where a name goes. A refusal answers error (these words), code and, when its words hold a name, names. An app shows its own words for a code that it knows, and error for any other. Each app's table has a case for every code here, with the same English.

codes.hub_changed_sending: hub generation changed; refresh state before sending
codes.team_changed_lines: team.json changed meanwhile; reload the reporting lines
codes.login_as_text: a registered login cannot be sent as text
codes.login_as_file: a registered login cannot be sent as a file
codes.login_not_shown: registered login text cannot be displayed
codes.command_reused: request_id was already used for a different command
codes.command_reused_message: request_id was already used for an owner message; send the answer with a new one
codes.command_reused_file: request_id was already used for another file
codes.command_reused_content: request_id was already used for different content or recipient
codes.command_interrupted: this command was interrupted and the hub does not know what came of it. Read the thing it was about, and send the command again with a new request_id if it did not take effect
codes.revision_unreadable: the hub cannot read its own revision
codes.knowledge_unread: the knowledge files cannot be read now; try again in a moment
codes.profile_unread: {agent}'s profile cannot be read now; try again in a moment
codes.signature_unchecked: the hub could not check the signature of this yes now; answer it again
codes.server_silent: {server} sent no reading in the last 10 minutes: check that it is on
codes.server_no_service: {server} has no server service: it did not join with a join code
codes.card_words_from_tool: This card has its own answers: an AI session or a program answers it only with one of them, the one that the owner chose. Send other words to the agent as a message; the card stays open for the owner.
codes.request_unknown_ended: owner request does not exist: a request whose task ended is gone with it
codes.not_owner_device: {address} is not an owner device. See "owner_devices" in team.json.
codes.not_owner_device_no_code: {address} is not an owner device, and that is not a code for a new one
codes.agent_mid_turn: {agent} is in the middle of a turn. Move it when the turn ends.
codes.agent_open_signin: {agent} has an open sign-in. Finish it or let it run out, then try again.
codes.time_passed: this time has passed; change the time first
codes.google_file_mode: the Google file of the hub must be a regular file of the hub user with mode 600
codes.google_file_unreadable: the Google file of the hub cannot be read: it is not a JSON object with accounts
codes.google_file_key: the hub cannot read the key of its Google file now
codes.google_file_lost: the Google file of the hub does not open with its key: connect each Google account again
codes.google_no_client: This hub's release has no Google client. Update the hub, then connect again.
codes.google_no_secret: Founderizer's Google app cannot be read from founderizer.com now, so nothing was started. Try again in a few minutes.
codes.connect_stale: This Connect expired, or another one took its place. Start Connect again.
codes.google_revoked_during: A Disconnect of this account came during this Connect, so nothing was connected. Start Connect again.
codes.drive_folder_link: That is not the link of a Drive folder.
codes.drive_folder_account: {account} is not connected for Google Drive now. Connect it again.
codes.drive_folder_unseen: {account} cannot open this folder. Share it with {account}, or connect the account that has it.
codes.drive_folder_file: That is the link of a file, not of a folder.
codes.drive_folder_google: Google did not answer about this folder: {reason}. Try again.
codes.repo_vendor: The door refuses {repo} in every fleet, so no grant of it works: leave it out.
codes.package_unread: {registry} did not give the record of {name} ({http_status})
codes.package_record_large: the record of {name} at {registry} is larger than {megabytes} MB
codes.package_too_new: {name} {version} was published on {day}, less than {days} days ago
codes.package_too_new_older: {name} {version} was published on {day}, less than {days} days ago; the newest version that is older is {newest}
codes.package_none_old: {name} has no release that is at least {days} days old
codes.mcp_registry_away: the MCP Registry cannot be reached now
codes.mcp_registry_no_list: the MCP Registry gave no list of servers
codes.mcp_no_endpoints: the MCP server {server} gave no OAuth endpoints: {reason}
codes.mcp_url_replaced: the MCP server {server} has text in its url that a session would replace with one of its own values, so no session loads it and it takes no sign-in. Change or remove the server with the save_mcp_server tool of an AI session that has the Founderizer tools
codes.mcp_token_refused: Fleet did not keep the sign-in of the MCP server {server}: the server gave an access token that a session could fill with one of its own values, or that no header takes. A new sign-in gets the same kind of token, so the server's maker must change it
codes.server_name_kept: This server is called {name} in Tailscale, and Fleet keeps that name for itself. Rename this server in Tailscale, then run the line again.
codes.browser_shell_off: {agent} cannot have a browser on a Linux server while its Shell box is off: turn its Shell box on, or its Browser box off
codes.browser_server: {server} runs no browser for an agent: in this version only a Linux server with x86 Ubuntu 24.04 or 26.04 that is not the hub's own server runs one
codes.browser_no_room: {server} has no room for the browser of {agent} beside its other agents: turn its Browser box off first, or move it to a server with more memory
codes.browser_no_place: {server} has no room for the browser of {agent}: turn its Browser box off first, or move it to a server with more memory
codes.browser_room_unknown: {server} has not said how much memory it has for browsers: turn the Browser box of {agent} off first, or move it to another server
codes.person_handles_most: a person has at most {most} handles
codes.bot_name_unknown: the bot has not said its name yet: try again when the bot is connected
codes.token_bot_account: a token is for a Discord or Telegram account
codes.takeover_closed: This step is answered or no longer open
codes.takeover_no_screen: {agent}'s screen cannot be opened now: its server or its Founderizer is not ready for it
codes.takeover_late: {agent}'s server did not open its screen in time: press Take over again
codes.takeover_no_browser: {agent}'s browser does not run now, so there is no screen to take over
codes.takeover_provider: {agent}'s browser shows an AI provider's site, which is never taken over
codes.takeover_screen_failed: {agent}'s server could not share its screen: press Take over again
codes.about_unreadable: {agent} cannot read this work in its chat, so it cannot get a message about it
codes.teams_off: This needs Founderizer for Teams, which this fleet does not have.
codes.teams_part_missing: This fleet has Founderizer for Teams, but its hub has not loaded this part of it.
codes.secret_value_asked: This request asks for a new value of {name}: type it in the request's form.
codes.secret_app_setting: {name} is a setting of an app on a host: its new value changes on that host, not here.
codes.role_sets_contacts_off: A role's access needs the setting contacts.v2, which is off.
codes.role_no_set: The role {role} has no access of its own.
codes.join_two: Two devices show this code. Send a new invite.
codes.join_file: An answer to this item carries no file.
codes.link_no_agent: This person can talk to no agent yet.
codes.link_active: A device already joined. Remove the row to share again.
codes.link_channel: This fleet's release channel is not Founderizer's own, so it makes no invite.
codes.link_file: The hub cannot open the key file of the Founderizer app's links.
codes.link_key: The hub cannot read the key of the Founderizer app's links now. Try again in a minute.
codes.link_most: This fleet has {most} Founderizer rows with an invite or a device, the most that it can have. Remove one first.
codes.link_from_tool: An invite is made in Founderizer on the Mac, never by an AI session or a program.
